# Optimity Technologies — AI products for specific workflows

> Optimity Technologies builds AI products for specific workflows. Its lead product, Move Concierge AI™, answers the calls a moving company misses and gives the team a complete lead to follow up. It also makes Property Connect AI™ for real-estate teams and Nexus AI™ for questions across business systems, and builds custom AI systems where a product doesn't fit.

Optimity is a team of senior engineers and architects in India, the USA and the UAE. Its products connect to the systems a business already runs. People stay in charge: the voice products pass complaints, unusual requests and anything they can't answer to staff, and Nexus AI only takes actions that have been approved.

## Products

- [Move Concierge AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/move-concierge.html): voice AI for moving companies. Answers the inbound and after-hours calls routed to it; asks about the move (date, origin and destination, home size, stairs and elevator access, large or fragile items); writes up a structured lead with recording and transcript; books a virtual or in-home estimate or a callback where configured; sends the caller an SMS or WhatsApp summary; and passes the lead to staff by email or in the moving software or CRM. It does not give binding prices, promise dates or agree to exceptions. Connects to Google Calendar or a dispatch or booking tool, MoveOps, Supermove, HubSpot, a webhook to the company's own database, SMS and WhatsApp Business.
- [Property Connect AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/property-connect.html): voice AI for real-estate teams. Calls new web leads back within a minute, answers listing questions, checks budget, pre-approval and timeline, books tours in agents' calendars and warm-transfers serious buyers after a private briefing. CRM sync with Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, HubSpot, Salesforce or custom webhooks.
- [Nexus AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/nexus-ai.html): plain-English questions across ERPNext, Odoo, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and documents, with the source of each answer shown. Three engines (SmartOps AI™, DocIntellect AI™, SQL Database Agent). Read-only SQL sandboxes, Clerk-based tenant isolation, private LLM deployment through vLLM, row-level access control; actions only where configured and approved.
- [All products](https://optimitytechnologies.com/products.html): short overview of the three.

## Custom AI systems

- [Custom AI Systems](https://optimitytechnologies.com/custom-ai-systems.html): focused workflows, agents, integrations and interfaces for operational needs the products don't cover, built around existing systems, preferring reusable components. Delivery: discover the workflow, configure, integrate, launch, improve. Code written only for a client belongs to the client; extensions of an Optimity product stay in the product.
